scope: CPU physics simulation and paired camera observations with prescribed joint motion.

git.head: cf58ed141ed1771f1ff8d2c53d6658c4054582f5
git.note: The script SHA256 below identifies executed code even if this tree was dirty.

seed_note: Scene and trajectory are deterministic; no random sampling is performed.
control: POSITION_CONTROL with sinusoidal prescribed joint targets

camera.convention: Column vectors; T_A_B maps B to A; metres; optical x right, y down, z forward.
camera.view_conversion: OpenGL view forward = optical +z; up = optical -y.
camera.synchronization: All four views rendered without intervening physics steps.
